labels: SHADOW/HYPOTHETICAL. Nothing submitted, filled, settled or realized. Venues never pooled.
complete_eligible_definition: after the first fill and while imbalanced, v2 returned recommended_relation == 'complete' at least once
SUPERSEDES: the 11:42Z figures PMUS 13 first fills / 0 matched / 1a_POLICY_NEVER_RECOMMENDED_COMPLETE 92.3%. With 38 first fills, P(COMPLETE-eligible | first fill) on PMUS is 50.0%, not 7.7%, and PMUS has matched 4 times. The early figure was sample-limited, not wrong arithmetic. This is the SECOND time today a PMUS read moved substantially with sample size, which is itself the argument for the 25-eligible checkpoint.
FUNNEL_IS_NOT_STRICTLY_MONOTONE_AND_HERE: COMPATIBLE FLOW (PMUS 5) exceeds REACHED (PMUS 4). That is not a bug. REACHED is evaluated on the 8-second BOOK sample; COMPATIBLE FLOW is evaluated on PRINTS, which are continuous. A print can land at or through the resting price in a gap where the sampled book never showed ask <= px. REACHED is therefore NOT a prerequisite for the later stages and must not be read as one.
MATCHED_IS_ON_THE_OPTIMISTIC_BRANCH: The inventory replay records a fill whenever a compatible print exists, so MATCHED tracks the OPTIMISTIC rule. The queue-aware bracket is reported separately and is much lower: PMUS 4 vs 5 optimistic, INTL 19 vs 43. Do not read MATCHED as queue-proven.
